summary: Wide arterial kerb where cars park, with houses 10-20 m away and a steep grade.

best_section.where: Carmody Road west kerb, curving bend north of the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit about 10-20 m behind the kerb on the same side (apartments 10 m at 36 m, houses 7 m at 66 m); houses also across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Open kerbside lane with several cars parked; room to pull in. Mapped gates are 280 m away on a way round.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with lane markings; constant road noise.
drivers.convention: Other cars park along the kerb, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade, up to 18% in short steps
Houses within 7-10 m just outside the section
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees and buildings on the west side give some morning shade.
